title: The light/dark toggle lives only in onboarding; afterwards theme is changed in Settings only
context: The onboarding-v7 decision kept the toggle in the app for good (macOS title bar, top right on Android). The new app prototype has no toggle in its chrome; the onboarding prototype moves it to a round glass button at the top left on both platforms.
options: keep it in the app and move it in onboarding
outcome: Owner: "Match the prototype. Regardless of macOS or Android, the user has the option to toggle Light/Dark mode throughout the onboarding process. After completion, the theme option lives in settings only." The toggle leaves the macOS title bar and the phone header; the shell unit keeps it in the macOS title bar only while onboarding shows until the onboarding unit hosts its own. Replaces the onboarding-v7 decision.
